project: Wuxia Life P57 Sample Lines Second 40+ Node
description: Optionally extend the closed sample-line track with at most one second 40+ payoff node per line, but only where an evidence-based audit shows real value beyond the existing age-45 payoff, without reopening the sample-line baseline or competing with higher-priority merchant_magnate and ordinary-origin growth work.

userStories.title: Audit whether second 40+ nodes are worth doing
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of whether each current sample line actually benefits from a second 40+ node so P57 is optional by evidence rather than habit.
acceptanceCriteria: Assess the completeness of the current age-45 payoff for orthodox, demonic, and merchant lines
Identify which lines have a real second-node gap and which do not
Save docs/test-reports/p57-sample-lines-second-40-plus-gap-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story

userStories.title: Lock optional scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want an explicit optional scope contract so P57 stays low-risk and does not quietly reopen the closed sample-line track.
acceptanceCriteria: State that P57 is lower priority than P55 and P56
Limit the stage to at most one new second node per line
List forbidden expansions: full lifetime sim, sample-line skeleton rewrite, fourth line, platformization
Save docs/test-reports/p57-sample-lines-second-40-plus-scope-contract.md

userStories.title: Define orthodox second-node contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded second-node contract for the orthodox line so any late-life extension adds a new stewardship payoff instead of repeating age-45.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the orthodox second-node theme and prerequisites
Document how it differs from age-45 legacy stewardship
Do not rewrite the orthodox core route
Record the contract in the PRD or audit appendix

userStories.title: Define demonic second-node contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded second-node contract for the demonic line so any late-life extension deepens backlash or rule-making instead of repeating age-45 territory consolidation.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the demonic second-node theme and prerequisites
Document how it differs from age-45 territory consolidation
Do not rewrite the demonic core route
Record the contract in the PRD or audit appendix

userStories.title: Define merchant second-node contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded second-node contract for the merchant line so any late-life extension deepens scale or succession pressure instead of repeating age-45 expansion fork.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the merchant second-node theme and prerequisites
Document how it differs from age-45 expansion fork
Keep existing merchant debt, favor, and expansion semantics intact
Record the contract in the PRD or audit appendix

userStories.title: Decide go or no-go per line
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a line-by-line go or no-go decision so P57 can skip weak candidates instead of forcing symmetry across all three lines.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce a go or no-go decision for each of the three lines
Allow one to three lines rather than forcing all three
Support each decision with evidence and scope reasoning
Record the decision in the scope contract or gap audit

userStories.title: Wire approved second-node configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want only the approved second nodes wired through bounded configuration changes so the optional late-life extension remains small and testable.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement configuration only for go-lines
Do not introduce a new sample-line framework
Existing age-40 and age-45 conclusions do not regress
Relevant targeted simulations can trigger the approved nodes

userStories.title: Add second-node player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want approved second nodes to appear on existing expression surfaces so the late-life extension is visible and not just hidden in flags.
acceptanceCriteria: Add second-node wording for go-lines only
Keep the wording distinct from age-45 payoff text
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests

userStories.title: Extend replay and guard narrowly
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow replay and guard coverage for any approved second nodes so optional late-life content cannot silently disappear later.
acceptanceCriteria: Add replay or guard assertions only for go-lines
Do not turn the cheap guard into a new large gate
Replay latest or a companion artifact shows the approved second nodes
Relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce P57 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a P57 closure report stating whether the optional second-node stage was worthwhile and which lines, if any, actually got extended.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p57-sample-lines-second-40-plus-closure-report.md
Summarize the audit, go-or-no-go decisions, configuration, expression, and verification evidence
State which lines got a second node and which remained no-go
Do not frame P57 as a mandatory sample-line stage
